Walmart's net income rose about 2.9% from fiscal Q1 2025 to fiscal Q4 2025, using net income attributable to Walmart. Fiscal 2025 ended January 31, 2025, so the two quarters are the three months ended April 30, 2024 and the three months ended January 31, 2025.

- **Q1 FY2025 (three months ended April 30, 2024):** $5,104 million, taken directly from the April 2025 10-Q's prior-year column.
- **Q4 FY2025 (three months ended January 31, 2025):** The filings give no standalone Q4 figure, so I derived it as full-year FY2025 less the nine months ended October 31, 2024: $19,436 million − $14,182 million = $5,254 million.
- **Change:** ($5,254 − $5,104) / $5,104 ≈ +2.9%.

On consolidated net income, which includes the noncontrolling interest, the change would be about +2.2% ($5,425 million vs. $5,307 million).
